Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS pref_name, drug_indication.mesh_id AS mesh_id, drug_indication.mesh_heading AS mesh_heading, drug_indication.efo_id AS indication_curie, drug_indication.efo_term AS indication_label, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase_for_ind
From molecule_dictionary
Join drug_indication On molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno
Where drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind = 4
Sort By molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, drug_indication.mesh_id, drug_indication.mesh_heading, drug_indication.efo_id, drug_indication.efo_term, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind
